hints: 25% is the same as one quarter, 1/4.
To find 1/4 of a number, divide it by 4.

solution.methodName: Change the percent to an easy fraction

steps.why: Divide the top and the bottom by 25. 25 goes into 100 exactly 4 times, like four 25-centavo coins in ₱1.
1/4 means you split 40 into 4 equal parts and take 1 part.
If the 4 equal parts add back to the whole, your part is right.

trapNotes.4: This divides by 10, which gives 10%. For 25%, divide by 4.
trapNotes.15: This subtracts 25 from 40. To find 25%, divide by 4 instead.
trapNotes.160: This multiplies 40 by 4. 25% is a part of 40, so the answer must be smaller than 40. Divide by 4.
